About.label: About me
About.subtitle: Food Photographer · Warsaw
About.p1: In my photography, I focus on the story of the place, the details and authenticity. Through food photography, I create images that not only resonate with regular guests but also capture the attention of new ones. They create experiences that stay in people's memory and engage the senses.
About.p2: Whether you want to improve your menu, strengthen your social media presence or build a cohesive visual identity, photography is a powerful tool that can support the growth of your business.
About.p3: I combine the experience of a professional chef with the perspective of a photographer, which allows me to truly understand the hospitality industry and its needs. I'd love to tell the story of your place through tailored food photography.
About.p4: If you want to do different project together (events, portraits), feel free to contact me and discuss the details.

Contact.label: Contact Me
Contact.subtitle: Share your project details and I'll reply with availability, timeline, and next steps.
